preprocessing.step1_resample: Resample to 2000 Hz. REQUIRED -- the network learned absolute durations.

step2_bandpass.method: Filter forward, reverse the signal, filter again, reverse back (filtfilt).

step3_normalise.scale: 99.5th percentile of abs(x) over the whole recording

padding.note: Pad both ends so a window can centre on the first and last sample.

inference.windowForCentre: centre c (1-based) uses padded samples c+1 .. c+windowLength
inference.output: 4 probabilities per frame, in the order given by classes[]

viterbi.order: S1 -> systole -> S2 -> diastole -> S1 (cyclic, left-to-right)
viterbi.allowedMoves: stay in the current state, or advance to the next. Nothing else.
viterbi.emission: log of the softmax posterior. Valid because training was class-balanced.

postprocessing.eventExtraction: Each maximal run of consecutive frames decoded as a state becomes ONE detection, placed at the frame with the highest posterior for that state within the run. Discard runs shorter than 2 frames.
postprocessing.heartRate: bpm = 60 / mean(diff(S1 detection times in seconds))
